question: Birju Maharaj was awarded which of the following awards in 2012?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Film Award.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Birju Maharaj **represented the **Lucknow "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana** of Kathak dance in India as a **dancer, composer, vocalist, and performer.**
 
• India's second-highest civilian accolade, the **Padma Vibhushan,** was given to **Birju Maharaj in 1986.**
 
• He won the** National Film Award for Best Choreography in 2012 **for the movie **Unnai Kaanadhu Naan**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sangam Kala Award:**

 
 
• This award includes an** honor-citation** and a** cash prize of 20,000 rupees.**
 
 
 
• **Filmfare Award:**
 
 
• The **Hindi-language film industry** in India is recognized annually for** artistic and technical excellence** with the Filmfare Awards.
 
• In **1954,** The **Times Group's Filmfare** magazine initially announced the awards.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:**
 
 
• The Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of** Music, Dance, and Drama, bestows this honor.** 
 
• Prior to 2003, the prize came with a citation, a tamrapatra, an angavastram (a shawl), and Rs. 50,000.
 
• The monetary award has grown to ₹1,00,000 since 2009.
